comments: 636c7922: The script processes and prints VistA Deficiency records, organizing them by patient, date, physician, or service.
c75583a6: Main loop: Iterate through divisions and process each according to the report type (PAT, DAT, PHY, SER).
37279c90: If user interrupts the output or if it completes successfully, proceed to the final report routine.
d369f82d: Exit point for the script, branching to the QUIT tag in DGJOPRT3.
6df5e732: Set the current division being processed.
d371b161: Retrieve and display division name from the hospital location file.
0c4b0f31: End of DIV tag.
6dfbbb5f: Format and print the report date.
e7f8cbc4: Iterate through patients for the current division.
b5bc8a8d: End of PAT tag.
f875333d: For each patient, iterate through their deficiencies and print details.
124d8136: End of PAT1 tag.
f1034ebb: If it's the first record, print the header.
3b5c42c9: Iterate through physicians, then patients, printing deficiencies.
c17d5ba7: End of PHY tag.
7f8b8cf8: For each patient under a physician, print their deficiencies.
b56b717c: End of PHY1 tag.
b8218210: Iterate through dates, then patients, printing deficiencies.
b9c0e9fc: End of DAT tag.
b98ff8be: For each patient on a date, print their deficiencies.
ebfbd5ab: End of DAT1 tag.
3e1536fc: If it's the first record for service, print the header.
a7655fee: Iterate through services, then specialties, printing deficiencies.
0ba2dcfb: End of SER tag.
d6617db5: For each patient in a service and specialty, print their deficiencies.
11a131f6: End of SER1 tag.
33a4e404: For each patient under a specialty in a service, print their deficiencies.
7a193eb9: End of SER2 tag.
713ebdf3: Prepare for printing the deficiency detail line.
7f8b1ef5: Set physician name for the deficiency, if applicable.
dae82564: If sorting by date, print the date at the start of the detail line.
51eb941d: If not sorting by date, simply start a new line for the record.
bba8e23d: Print the first 15 characters of the patient's name.
21784192: Print the patient identifier next to the name.
b6ced931: If not sorting by date, print the date of the deficiency next.
49c3e337: Print the discharge type if applicable.
9c12b016: Print the clinic name associated with the deficiency.
7e9bee6f: Prepare and print the most recent tracking location for the item.
9fdea31a: Print the latest status update for the deficiency.
19d96c17: If sorting by physician, print additional header information.
75ab1882: Print the physician responsible for the deficiency.
8ce9250a: Print the service associated with the deficiency.
86a83609: If directed, print the deficiency's detailed type.
dae8a684: Print the deficiency length.
60e3f8fe: End of PRT2 tag.
d6ea2b92: Delegate to DGJOPRT3 for header printing.
8de076eb: Handle pagination for patient and date sorting when not on a console.
a14f80e5: Check if output is not to a console, skip if it is.
00037f32: Advance to the bottom of the page for non-console display.
c995fca9: Display division on report and handle console pagination.
acc1a619: Prompt user to continue or quit on interactive devices.
69ee2bb5: Handle pagination for patient/date sorting, with header reprinting if necessary.
247bc31b: General pagination handling, with header reprinting if not on a console.
950b3234: End of RELP tag.
46d6f0f0: Print the division header for the report section.
c3bd9377: Print the physician header for the report section.
9b900e45: Print the service header for the report section.
b5e1125d: Print the specialty header for the report section.
4836a5ad: Delegate to DGJOPRT3 for additional physician handling.
65513825: Delegate to DGJOPRT3 for additional service handling.
